lines.en: - Happy Valentine's Day. - How are you, too?
Hey, so, uh, how's it going, living over at Ross's?
It's good, except he makes us watch
the Discovery Channel all day long.
Did you know that something really boring
happened to someone really ugly in the Middle Ages?
Oh, thank you. I'll see you guys later.
- Okay, bye. - Bye.
I have one lucky-to-go cup of coffee.
Honey, I wish you would get over her.
I hate seeing you like this.
Is there anything I can do for you?
Do you want to look down my top?
Thanks, but maybe later.
Oh, Gunther, could I get a scone?
Do you want anything?
I don't know what I want. I want a lot of things.
I want to be with the woman I love on Valentine's Day.
And I want her to love me back.
And I want just one moment of relief
from the gut-wrenching pain
and knowing that that's never going to happen.
We have red bagels.
Okay.
